characters.name: 贺师傅
characters.design: A 58-year-old male watchmaker with short graying hair, wearing a worn dark brown vest over a crisp white shirt, a single magnifying loupe over his right eye, steady dexterous hands, realistic textured skin and worn fabric, warm nostalgic tone, medium shot suitable for close-up of hands and face.

characters.name: 林小满
characters.design: A 22-year-old female college student with long straight black hair, wearing a cream knit cardigan and plaid skirt, red swollen eyes, holding an old women's watch, soft vulnerable expression with tears, realistic warm tone, medium shot focusing on facial expression and hands.

props.name: 旧女表
props.design: Old women's mechanical watch with a slightly worn silver case, stopped at a specific fixed time, faint scratches on the surface, realistic metallic texture, warm low-contrast tone, close-up shot suitable for showing fine details.

props.name: 修表工作台
props.design: Worn wooden watch repair workbench scattered with tiny gears, tweezers and watch parts, a green-shaded work lamp placed on top, glass display cabinet in soft background, realistic worn wood texture, warm ambient lighting, medium shot showing the whole workbench surface.

props.name: 单目放大镜
props.design: Single-eye magnifying loupe with metal frame and clear glass lens, worn realistic texture, close-up shot suitable for showing detail on the wearer's face and watch parts.

scenes.name: 修表铺工作台场景
scenes.design: Intimate medium shot of a workbench in an old city watch repair shop, soft top-down illumination from the green-shaded work lamp, supplemented by warm ambient light from wall clocks and wooden cabinet lamps, scattered watch parts on the wooden surface, low-contrast warm desaturated tone with fine film grain, quiet nostalgic atmosphere, focus on the workbench and characters' hands.
